channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-playwright
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: supercov — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Wraps an existing Playwright test run to report line, branch and MC/DC coverage per test, worker and retry, without config or a custom reporter.

item.title: playwright-opentelemetry — via awesome-playwright
item.description: OpenTelemetry reporter for Playwright with trace propagation, OTLP export, and a viewer pairing screenshots with backend spans.

item.title: Cutaway — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Coding agents record polished demo videos of web flows from a JSON script, with a zooming camera, a human-paced cursor and motion blur.

item.title: pixelpact — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Extracts a visual contract from a reference page and reports the size, color, spacing and typography values that drifted in an implementation.

item.title: playwright-soak-test — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Catches memory leaks by repeating a user flow in one browser session and tracking DOM node and listener counts.

item.title: Webcmd — via awesome-playwright
item.description: CLI built on Playwright that learns a site's navigation once and compiles it into deterministic per-site commands for coding agents.

item.title: AntiBrow — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Patched Chromium that returns a standard Playwright BrowserContext over CDP, with fingerprints applied in the C++ layer instead of injected scripts. MIT SDKs for Python and JavaScript, plus an MCP server mode.
